hints.title: Concurrent Resolution Collection
hints.text: Coordinate multiple pending asynchronous operations concurrently and gather individual success or failure outcomes without premature aborts.

hints.title: Index Preserving Completion Counter
hints.text: Store each fulfilled or rejected outcome directly at the original index and resolve the overarching promise once all tasks complete.

hints.title: AllSettled Blueprint
hints.text: Iterate over functions, execute each fn(), and inside then and catch write { status, value/reason } to results[i], checking if completed count equals n.

hints.title: Complete Implementation

complexity.notes: Executes all tasks in parallel; resolution triggers after slowest task completes.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Promise.all rejects immediately upon the first failure, dropping all other concurrently running results.
complexity.spaceTimeTradeoff: Allocates an output array of length N to store individual statuses.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Accurate preservation of input index order regardless of resolution timing.
